answer.evidence: Step Rx loss at 2026-10-25 11:00 after street-cabinet patching, with Tx normal and B attenuator giving 3.06 dB. Bidirectional embedded and dual-wavelength handheld OTDR show one wavelength-independent reflective ~3.7 dB event at 26.05 km fibre from A, mapping to MID-PP (25.325 route km after fibre excess/slack). MID-PP scope showed scratched/chipped end face vs clean A/B ODFs, and prior cleaning produced no change, indicating physical damage not dirt.

checklist.item: Run handheld OTDR event tables at 1550 and 1310 nm (consider timing/budget) from appropriate site(s) to characterise event wavelength dependence and reflectance

checklist.item: Inspect connectors and examine OTDR traces/images around suspect event as indicated

args.evidence: Step Rx loss at 2026-10-25 11:00 after street-cabinet patching, with Tx normal and B attenuator giving 3.06 dB. Bidirectional embedded and dual-wavelength handheld OTDR show one wavelength-independent reflective ~3.7 dB event at 26.05 km fibre from A, mapping to MID-PP (25.325 route km after fibre excess/slack). MID-PP scope showed scratched/chipped end face vs clean A/B ODFs, and prior cleaning produced no change, indicating physical damage not dirt.

evidence_refs.quote: Patching work at street cabinet patch panel: jumpers moved to free a port for a new service.
Connector at street cabinet patch panel cleaned with click cleaner after low Rx reported. No change in Rx power.
